en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a town market square surrounded by multi‑storey gabled houses with shops at street level. In the foreground is an open square with a low, covered well or fountain structure. Leafless or sparsely leafed trees line the elevated sidewalk in front of the right-hand buildings. The scene is labeled in red Gothic/antiqua script at the top, and a vertical imprint appears along the left edge.
